title: xDrip - Variable for Notification Graph
body:
Hey guys 

I have a question. I would like to know which variable xdrip uses for the graph in the notification. I would like to export the graph. does anyone know anything about it? we got 2 graphs a small one at the normal notfication and the big what in extendet view. I think there could be a way to get it out of.

Thanks for your time :)
